create_GPUState: create a GPUState instance with a given gpu_id and max_total_tokens to simulate GPU memory allocation
build_StepRecord: build a StepRecord capturing step, gpu_id, running and pending request counts for scheduling simulation
test_GPUState_is_valid: test the GPUState is_valid method to check if total sequence length fits within max_total_tokens
run_GPUState_execute_step: run the GPUState execute_step method to simulate one decoding step across all running requests
review_GPUState_evict_request: review the GPUState evict_request method that moves a running request back to the pending queue
